Дифеманила Метилсульфат C20H24N,CH3SO4 = 389.5. CAS — 62-97-5. ATC — A03AB15. ATC Vet — QA03AB15. Profile Diphemanil metilsulfate is a quaternary ammonium antimus- carinic with peripheral effects similar to those of atropine (p.1219). It is used topically as a 2% cream or powder to treat hyperhidrosis (p.1580). Diphemanil metilsulfate, given orally, has been used for the treat- ment of symptomatic bradycardia in infants. ◊ References. 1. Vidal AM, et al.
